questions.question: Discuss the classification of carbohydrates, including their functions, types (monosaccharides, disaccharides, oligosaccharides, polysaccharides), and dietary sources.?
questions.solution_html:
• Carbohydrates- Carbohydrates are the most abundant organic molecules in
  • nature and the major functional constituents of living cells. A carbohydrate is
  • a biomolecule consisting of carbon (C), hydrogen (H) and oxygen (O) atoms, usually
  • with a hydrogen–oxygen atom ratio of 2:1 (as in water). Classification-
  • Monosaccharides-The word “Monosaccharides” derived from the Greek word
  • “Mono” means Single and “saccharide” means sugar. Monosaccharides are simple
  • sugars. They are sweet in taste. They are soluble in water. They are crystalline in
  • nature. Eg; glucose, fructose, galactose 2. Disaccharides-Disaccharides are produced
  • from the condensation of 2 monosaccharide molecules. Eg; lactose, maltose, sucrose.
